![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb7133813ad560d48426fbb901dad796046f2679.png)
# ✦ IdentityMimic — The Ultimate Social Deception Engine ✦

> **IdentityMimic** is a high-fidelity social deception framework that transforms your Minecraft SMP server into a playground of paranoia, viral betrayals, and high-stakes espionage. Perfect for content creators, roleplay servers, and competitive communities.

Unlike basic `/disguise` plugins that feel cheap, glitchy, and easily detectable, **IdentityMimic** is built around an advanced ProtocolLib-driven **Decoy Co-existence engine**. It manages fake join/leave messages and decoy tablist profiles to ensure your disguise transitions are completely seamless and invisible to other players.

---

## 📸 Immersive Previews

### 💼 The Interactive Soul Vault GUI
Store, preview, and manage your collection of stolen player identities in a dark-themed interactive RPG-style vault menu. You can track your Soul Energy (XP) progression, upgrade slots, and trigger active deception powers.

![Vault](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01340f66413ffb738d218e37af5401064ed120f7.png)

### 🔮 The Cinematic Ritual of Assumption
Switching forms is not instant—it is a highly immersive, vulnerable **channeling ritual** featuring an animated BossBar tracker, custom sound effects, void particle clouds, and a split-second blindness vignette right before the identity binds.

![ritual](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d03a8531a80662796345ef035c048e71516588b_0.webp)

### 🔋 Stability & Heat HUD
Disguises are unstable. Sprinting, jumping, and taking damage build up **Heat** and decay your **Stability**. At low stability, your skin will flicker and your nametag will display random matrix characters to nearby players.

![stability](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/591f8e6bffd70a550897bc9673390a1e385a691a_0.webp)

---

## 💎 Premium Core Features

* **🎭 Decoy Co-existence Engine (Social Stealth):** When player A disguises as B, player A's original profile remains in the tablist for a randomized duration before sending a fake leave message. When player A undisguises, the B profile stays online as a decoy before fake leaving. No simultaneous join/leave notifications to trigger suspicion.
* **🧪 Unidirectional Potion Synchronization:** Disguised clones automatically receive and mirror active potion effects (like strength, speed, poison, or invisibility) from the real target player B. Clones do not share effects back, maintaining a flawless cover.
* **🔮 Cinematic Channeling:** A vulnerability-focused morphing sequence with animated BossBars, particle sweeps, and customized sound design. Any physical movement cancels the ritual!
* **💼 The Soul Vault:** Interactive chest menu to hold, preview, and discard identity shards. Upgrade your vault capacity from 3 slots to a legendary 7-slot collection.
* **🔋 Dynamic Stability & Heat:** Behave like your target to maintain cover. Running, jumping, or fighting increases your Heat level and causes skin glitches and matrix-style nametag flickers.
* **⚔️ RPG Progression & Abilities:** Collect Soul Energy (XP) to unlock and activate powerful abilities directly from the vault:
  * **Paranoia Whisper:** Spoof scary whispers to targeted players.
  * **System Glitch:** Cause massive glitch pulses.
  * **Fake OP Announcement:** Spoof operator status messages in chat.
  * **Fake Death / Admin Broadcasts:** Manipulate chat alerts to create chaos.
* **💾 Multi-Database Sync:** Native SQLite and MySQL support to persist disguises, skins, and vault contents across server restarts, reloads, and player rejoins.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

| Command | Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/identity vault` | `identitymimic.use` | Opens the Soul Vault GUI |
| `/identity equip <name>` | `identitymimic.use` | Initiates transformation to a stored identity |
| `/identity undisguise` | `identitymimic.use` | Reverts back to your original player skin/identity |
| `/identity discard <name>` | `identitymimic.use` | Discards an identity shard from your vault |
| `/identity stats` | `identitymimic.use` | View your current stability, heat, and soul energy stats |
| `/identity debug` | `identitymimic.admin` | View real-time packet synchronizations and state (Admin) |

---

## 📦 Requirements & Quick Installation

1. Download the plugin jar and place it in your server's `plugins/` directory.
2. Install **ProtocolLib 5.2.0+** (Required for packet manipulation and skin spoofing).
3. Ensure your server is running **Paper 1.21.1+**.
4. Restart your server to generate configuration files and database connections.
